Ravi (Support): Heads-up — Verde Labs onboarding is blocked by SSO failures. Trial ends in 4d, TAM escalated. Customers hitting 401 on SAML assertion after IdP redirect. Sending logs & trace below. Can CS own comms and run a hold-call? @Emma?

Priya (Support Eng): Pasting relevant log snippet:```
2026-03-22T17:02:11Z ERROR saml-handler RequestID=abc123 status=401 reason=InvalidAssertion
2026-03-22T17:02:11Z DEBUG saml Extracted NameID: null
```
Also saw an assertion timestamp skew of ~6m; IdP claims time looks okay.

alerts-bot: Incident #INC-2026-738 created for Verde Labs SSO error (priority: high). Assigned to support-eng.

Emma (CS): Acknowledged. I can take comms. Quick q: is the customer on Dedicated or Hosted? That affects suggested mitigations.

Ravi (Support): Hosted (prod.hosted.redwood.ai). Customer using Okta. We reproduced from their test tenant.

Emma (CS): Plan suggestion: 1) Rapid ack email to TAM/customer with ETA for follow-up (within 1h). 2) Daily 9am PST troubleshooting standup until resolved. 3) Temporary workaround: provision invite token flow so users can finish onboarding while we fix SSO. 4) Postmortem + renewal signal update. I'll draft the ack.

Mateo (Customer Success Manager): I'll join the standups and lead the renewal-risk comms. Can we get a short status blurb I can forward to execs?

Avery (CS Ops): I have a 2-line status template we use. Copy below for quick send: "We are aware of SSO login errors impacting Verde Labs' onboarding. Our engineers are investigating; next update within 2 hours. Temporary manual invite flow available. We are prioritizing a fix — CS lead: Emma (emma@redwood.ai)."

Emma (CS): Perfect — sending that now. Priya, can you keep me posted if the assertion timestamp skew is a red herring? If so, we'll escalate IdP contact path.

Priya (Support Eng): Will do. I opened a quick-check ticket with Okta SSO logs and flagged the assertion timestamps. If no progress in 60m, I'll request a deeper SAML trace from their IdP admin.

Ravi (Support): Thanks everyone. Action items: Emma -> ack + daily standup (owner); Mateo -> exec/status forwarding; Priya -> triage + IdP trace; Avery -> provide status template (done).

Emma (CS): Call scheduled: https://meet.redwood.ai/verde-sso-2026 (daily 09:00 PST). I'll kick off first 30m troubleshooting + enablement for their team.

Mateo (Customer Success Manager): :thumbsup: I updated renewal tracker to "at risk" until resolved.

Emma (CS): I'll post follow-ups here after each standup.

alerts-bot: Ticket INC-2026-738 — status updated to "investigating".
